input.command:
python3 -c "
# Chair legs:
# Front-left leg: c ~ 15-20, r ~ 417
# Front-right leg: c ~ 65-70, r ~ 417
# Back-left leg: c ~ 55-60, r ~ 388
# Back-right leg: c ~ 100-105, r ~ 388

x_cam = 1.433
y_cam = 2.616
f = 256.0
H = 1.55

legs = [(17.5, 417), (67.5, 417), (57.5, 388), (102.5, 388)]
coords = []
for u, v in legs:
    Z = f * H / (v - 256.0)
    X = (u - 256.0) / (v - 256.0) * H
    wx = x_cam + X
    wy = y_cam + Z
    coords.append((wx, wy))
    print(f'Leg at ({u:.1f},{v}): Z={Z:.3f}, X={X:.3f} -> world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')

avg_x = sum(c[0] for c in coords) / 4
avg_y = sum(c[1] for c in coords) / 4
print(f'Chair center: ({avg_x:.3f}, {avg_y:.3f})')
"
